verdict.rationale: Video translation with voice and lip-sync carry-over is a fair question for an AI video generation product, so the axis applies. Nothing in the pack documents translation, dubbing, voice cloning or lip sync. The nearest features, facial-expression transfer, Modify Video and agents that work across audio, are adjacent capabilities and do not deliver this story.

support.subject: As a marketer, I can translate a finished video into other languages with the voice and lip sync carried over
